justification: Both show a schematic head in profile with an incised oval eye and body surfaces covered by parallel incised lines suggesting feathers or hair, which is the only specific correspondence. A is a three-dimensional composite of crouched, stacked figures with rounded volumes seen in the round, while B is a flat single bust-length figure in strict profile with a beaked or hooked nose, ear ornament and a fanned wing of ruled parallel lines, so the compositions and conventions differ substantially.
